run_note: Criteria evolved vs 2026-06-06 baseline (prior run used >=1000 sqft, $2.0-2.2M, 2BR+ OK, D15/D19 only). Tonight uses the refined brief below.

criteria.tenure_99yr_conditional: 99yr OK only if (a) TOP within 10yrs AND <100 units, OR (b) larger project (<=~500 units) where some 3BR stacks exceed 1,110 sqft (e.g. Kovan Residences)
districts_primary: D19 (Kovan, Serangoon, Hougang, Bartley, Woodleigh, MacPherson)
districts_d14: D14 Eunos / Paya Lebar ONLY — Geylang excluded

Floor/level data was absent from nearly all snippets.
